rules.message: anti-hall git-guard: BLOCKED. Force push detected. Rewriting published history is a deliberate human action - do it manually with explicit owner confirmation, never from an automated push.

anti-hall git-guard: BLOCKED. Commit message contains an AI/assistant self-credit trailer (Co-Authored-By / "Generated with <AI>"). Remove it - commits carry no AI co-author credit. Re-run the commit without that trailer.
`rm -rf` on / or the home directory. Confirm with the owner before deleting data.
